What We Do
Electrical Services
🏠

Residential Wiring

Complete home wiring, rewiring, and electrical system upgrades for new builds and renovations throughout the Okanagan.

🏢

Commercial Electrical

Reliable electrical solutions for offices, retail spaces, and commercial buildings — designed for safety and efficiency.

🔌

Panel Upgrades

Modernize your electrical panel to handle today's power demands safely. We upgrade 100A, 200A, and larger service panels.

💡

Lighting Installation

Interior and exterior lighting design and installation, including LED retrofits, pot lights, landscape lighting, and more.

⚡

EV Charger Installation

Certified installation of Level 2 EV chargers for your home or business. Future-proof your property for electric vehicles.

🔧

Repairs & Troubleshooting

Fast, reliable troubleshooting and electrical repairs. We diagnose issues quickly and fix them right the first time.

🏠

New Construction Wiring

Complete rough-in and finish wiring for new home builds and additions throughout Kelowna and the Okanagan. Built to BC code from the ground up.

About Us
Your Trusted Kelowna Electrician

Harika Electric Inc. was founded by Handeep Singh Harika, a licensed BC electrician committed to delivering honest, high-quality work throughout Kelowna and the Okanagan Valley.

Whether you need a simple outlet installation or a full commercial build-out, our team delivers quality workmanship that meets all BC electrical codes and safety standards.
